parent_amendment.policy: Amendment 01 remains unchanged. This amendment changes only the Stage 3 horizon definition after a pre-execution artifact audit showed that its literal best-checkpoint rule yields 200 steps rather than a long horizon.

pre_execution_observation.source: Previously existing FullControl-P5 Development training records
pre_execution_observation.consequence: The Amendment 01 best-checkpoint definition gives T_star=200 for every seed and would duplicate the validated short horizon.

amended_equal_billing_long_horizon.horizon_definition: Freeze T_long=1,200 optimizer steps for every seed, equal to the complete six-epoch patience-five stopping schedule recorded by all three existing FullControl-P5 runs. T_long is fixed before any Stage 3 endpoint or Development prediction is produced.
amended_equal_billing_long_horizon.ordered_schedule: For each seed, concatenate the six deterministic epoch orders produced by the existing P5 epoch-order function from the frozen 3,200-row adaptation window.
matched_schedule: Original-T_long, Exact-Masked-T_long and BOTA-T_long use the same source initialization and fixed LoRA-A coordinate.
They use exactly 1,200 optimizer steps, identical ordered sample slots and the same 16-slot full-batch denominator.
Exact-Masked-T_long zeros registered-user slot weights without compacting retained data.
BOTA-T_long uses FS_empirical_fisher, frozen by Stage 1 before Stage 2 or Stage 3 outcomes were inspected.
amended_equal_billing_long_horizon.reporting: Report all six seed-by-scenario cells and mean plus sample standard deviation by scenario. No significance claim is permitted from three seeds.
amended_equal_billing_long_horizon.retain_retrain_policy: Retain-Retrain-P5 remains an independently stopped converged sensitivity endpoint and is neither loaded as nor used as the denominator for Stage 3 local residual.
amended_equal_billing_long_horizon.interpretation_rule: Movement toward Exact-Masked-T_long supports long-horizon local approximation only. It does not establish equivalence to independently converged retain-only retraining. Failure limits BOTA to its previously validated 200-step horizon.

unchanged_rules: Stage 3 is secondary and cannot replace the parent L8 and L4M4 primary results.
All seeds, scenarios, endpoints, required metrics, null results and adverse results must be reported.
No Stage 3 result may be used to change the frozen FS_empirical_fisher mechanism arm.
Any further change to the horizon, schedule, endpoint, metric or interpretation rule requires a new dated amendment before affected results are inspected.
